device: iPhone 16 or 17, iOS 26.x (or the newest release), Home Screen app; primary device: tier mobile at 60 fps

steps.instruction: Add the preview URL to the Home Screen and launch it from the icon.
Open <preview>/?perf=1&tier=mobile. The HUD must show 'mobile  webgl2' (webgpu.mobile is false until the iPhone 15 run decides it). Note the refresh rate shown in notes.json rafHz after Export.
Tap Export once. Keep notes.json: signals, persist(), estimate(), UA. If a second iPhone model is available, its signals are an extra fixture, not a replacement.
Tap 'Run 10 min' on the HUD and leave the app in the foreground for 10 minutes.
Tap Export; save perf.json and notes.json to docs/device-spike/M01c/iphone16/.

Run: pnpm perf:verify -- docs/device-spike/M01c/iphone16/perf.json --tier mobile --checklist tools/ci/checklists/M01c-iphone16.json (60 fps: median <= 17.54 ms, p95 <= 25.05 ms). Record the numbers in docs/device-spike/M01c-report.md. A miss is a finding for M11a, not a merge blocker.
If this phone has more RAM than the iPhone 15 (12 GB class), run <preview>/qa/memory-bomb.html as in the iPhone 15 checklist and record the total at the kill.
